text:
elaine: quick heads-up - reproducible issue in Kotlin sampleapp: streaming upload + cross-host redirect drops Authorization header on second hop (Pixel 8 emulator, Android 14).

marc: what error are you seeing? 401 or connection reset?

elaine: 401 from storage host. Initial POST to ingest.example.com includes Authorization, server responds with 307 to storage.example.com, okhttp follows and header is gone, streaming RequestBody aborts.

toni: classic OkHttp behavior - it removes 'Authorization' for cross-host redirects. Did you try an Authenticator?

elaine: we prototyped two workarounds: 1) followRedirects(false) and do manual follow while reusing headers; 2) use an Authenticator to reattach token on challenge. Both have tradeoffs.

marc: manual follow requires rewinding the RequestBody. FileInputStream can't rewind, so you either buffer (bad for large files) or fail. For small onboarding samples buffering is OK but not ideal.

toni: Authenticator only runs on 401/407 challenges, not automatically on redirect hops. So if the redirect returns 307 without challenge you won't get a callback. That means manual follow might still be necessary.

elaine: right. For the sampleapp we added a tiny helper: if response.isRedirect() && newHost != oldHost then close original and perform manual POST with preserved headers. We buffer up to 1.5MB for demo rewinds and error out above that.

marc: can we add docs guidance: avoid multi-host redirects for streaming uploads; prefer signed upload URLs or server-side single redirect? That would be the best long-term DX.

toni: agreed. Also add an Authenticator snippet to samples to show how to handle auth challenges and note the limitations. Example snippet: 

```
class TokenAuthenticator(private val provider: TokenProvider) : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    val newToken = provider.refreshIfNeeded()
    return response.request.newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $newToken")
      .build()
  }
}
```

elaine: we'll include that and a small manual-redirect helper in sampleapp, plus a short blurb in onboarding that signed URLs are recommended for large streaming uploads. Keep samples minimal to avoid onboarding friction.

marc: also note okhttp 4.x vs 5.x differences for header retention in our migration doc. We hit surprises there.

toni: CI action: add an e2e test using MockWebServer to simulate 307->302 chain and assert client behavior on emulator and a real device in our device lab.

elaine: opened ticket DEVEX-6022 to track: "Kotlin SDK: cross-host redirect drops auth for streaming uploads (sampleapp + docs)" and added PR checklist.

sdk-bot: ticket DEVEX-6022 created and linked to sampleapp repro; assigning to @elaine.

marc: one more note: cookie jar behavior differed on emulator in our runs so check cookie domain handling separately; could be contributing to flaky auth.

elaine: good call. I'll validate cookieJar behavior across emulator/device in the PR. Thanks folks :thumbsup: Closing thread and will update DEVEX-6022 with PR link when ready.
